Custom plastic cups with logo: choose the right format

Compare custom stadium cups, frosted plastic cups, plastic tumblers and stemware using the recorded material and serving capacity. For bulk plastic cups with logo, specify the cup, lid or straw, artwork and quantities per design.

Custom plastic cups · stadium cups ↗Custom plastic cups · frosted cups ↗Screen printing ↗UV printing ↗
How do I choose plastic cups with lids and straws?

Use the exact model and component references. Nominal capacity alone does not establish lid or straw fit. Confirm the chosen components and packing in the specification.

BROWSE BY CATEGORY

Custom Tumblers ↗Custom Stadium Cups ↗Custom Shot Glasses ↗Custom Beer Mugs ↗Custom Wine Glasses ↗Custom Champagne Flutes ↗Clear Plastic Cups ↗16 Oz Custom Cups ↗

Stadium, frosted or tumbler: which plastic cup format fits your programme?

Stadium cups suit tournaments and tailgates with large print areas, frosted cups give a matte finish for logo work, and tumblers cover travel and gifting. Confirm capacity, wall thickness and lid or straw fit against the exact model before sampling.

What is the minimum order for custom plastic cups?

The minimum depends on the model, material and print method. Send the model reference and quantity and we confirm the actual minimum — we do not quote one blanket number.

Which print method lasts longest on plastic cups?

Screen printing and UV printing are the standard options. Durability depends on the surface and washing conditions, so we confirm the method against your artwork and the selected model.

Are the cups dishwasher safe?

Washing limits are model-specific. Request the guidance for the exact reference you plan to order.

Plastic water bottles, handled tumblers and travel cups

Tritan and PP water bottles, handled tumblers and travel cups are produced in the same injection and printing lines as our stadium cups. Capacities run from 16 oz to 32 oz, with Tritan for clarity and impact resistance, PP for lightweight programmes and acrylic for a glass-like finish. Logos are applied by screen printing or UV printing depending on the surface and artwork; laser marking is used where the material allows it. Send the model reference and quantity so we can confirm capacity, lid and straw fit before sampling.

Blank drinkware for resellers, sublimation and decal programmes

Blank and unbranded cups are supplied for resellers, Etsy sellers and decorators who apply their own artwork. Options include blank tumblers, blank can coolers and blank pint cups in Tritan, PP and acrylic, plus UV DTF cup wraps and decals for customers who prefer a wrap rather than direct printing. Private label and white label packing are available. Tell us the decoration method you use and we will confirm a compatible surface.

Colour-changing, mood and glow cups

Colour-changing and mood cups react to cold liquid, which makes them a repeat order item for bars, resorts and event promoters. Glow and LED effects are covered on the LED drinkware page. Colour change is applied over a plastic body, so the base model, capacity and print method are confirmed together before sampling.

Do you supply blank cups for sublimation or resale?

Blank tumblers, can coolers and pint cups are supplied for resellers and decorators. Tell us which decoration method you use — heat transfer, UV DTF wrap or direct print — and we confirm a compatible surface before you order.

Can you print Tritan water bottles and handled tumblers?

Tritan bottles and handled tumblers are printed by screen or UV printing depending on the surface and artwork. Send the model reference and quantity and we confirm the method and print area.

Are colour-changing cups available in bulk?

Colour-changing and mood cups are produced in bulk over plastic bodies. Confirm the base model and capacity first, because the colour-change layer is applied to a specific body.

定制 Logo 塑料杯：按器型选款

根据已记录材料与使用容量比较体育场杯、磨砂塑料杯、随行杯和高脚杯。批量 Logo 定制需说明杯型、杯盖或吸管、图稿及每版数量。

定制塑料杯 · stadium cups ↗定制塑料杯 · frosted cups ↗丝印 ↗UV 印刷 ↗
怎样选带盖和吸管的塑料杯？

使用具体型号与配件参考，标称容量本身不能证明杯盖或吸管适配；在规格中确认组件和包装。

按品类浏览

定制随行杯 ↗定制球场杯 ↗定制子弹杯 ↗定制啤酒杯 ↗定制酒杯 ↗定制香槟杯 ↗透明塑料杯 ↗

球场杯、磨砂杯还是随行杯：怎么选

球场杯适合赛事与赛前聚会，印刷面积大；磨砂杯表面适合 Logo 印刷；随行杯覆盖出行与赠礼场景。容量、壁厚和杯盖吸管适配按具体型号确认后再打样。

定制塑料杯的起订量是多少？

起订量按型号、材料和印刷工艺确定。提供型号与数量后确认该配置的实际起订量，不报统一数字。

哪种印刷工艺在塑料杯上更耐用？

常用丝印与 UV 印刷。耐用性取决于表面与清洗条件，按图稿和型号确认。

塑料杯可以机洗吗？

清洗限制按型号提供，请在下单前索取对应型号说明。

塑料水瓶、带柄随行杯与旅行杯

Tritan 与 PP 水瓶、带柄随行杯和旅行杯与球场杯共用注塑和印刷线。容量覆盖 16–32 oz：Tritan 透明抗冲击，PP 轻便，亚克力接近玻璃质感。Logo 按表面和图稿选择丝印或 UV 印刷，材料允许时用激光打标。提供型号与数量后，先确认容量、杯盖和吸管适配，再安排打样。

空白杯：转售、热转印与贴纸方案

空白未印刷杯供应给转售商、Etsy 卖家和自行加工的买家。可选 Tritan、PP 与亚克力材质的空白随行杯、空白罐套和空白品脱杯，也提供 UV DTF 杯贴与贴纸，适合不用直接印刷的客户。支持白标与贴牌包装。请说明您用的加工方式，我们确认适配表面。

温变杯、情绪杯与夜光杯

温变杯遇冷变色，是酒吧、度假村和活动方反复下单的品类；夜光与 LED 效果在 LED 酒具页说明。变色层附着在塑料杯体上，因此杯型、容量和印刷工艺需在打样前一起确认。

是否供应空白杯用于热转印或转售？

供应空白随行杯、空白罐套和空白品脱杯给转售商与加工商。请说明您用热转印、UV DTF 杯贴还是直接印刷，我们确认适配表面。

Tritan 水瓶和带柄随行杯可以印刷吗？

Tritan 水瓶与带柄随行杯按表面和图稿选择丝印或 UV 印刷。提供型号与数量后确认工艺和印刷面积。

温变杯可以批量做吗？

温变杯与情绪杯以塑料杯体批量生产。先确认杯型与容量，因为变色层附着在特定杯体上。
